svg.text: BED v7 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build the case on the floor: Back, Sides, Bottom, Top, then THREE full-height dividers.
2. Fit the FOUR separate shelf panels; do not replace them with one wide shelf.
3. Drill modelled cable passages, fit under-bridge LED profile and route DC cables.
4. Lift with assistance and temporary support. Fix to the wall and adjacent towers.
5. Select fixings for the wall and expected load before removing temporary support.
